summary: This directory contains a comprehensive library of reusable UI components. It provides foundational building blocks for application interfaces, ensuring consistent styling, behavior, and interaction patterns across the user interface.
responsibilities: Providing atomic UI elements like buttons, inputs, and checkboxes.
Offering complex, multi-part components such as cards, fields, and selects.
Managing interface layout and structure through specialized containers and grouping components.
Ensuring consistent visual themes and state management for interactive elements.
Centralizing the export of all shared UI components for application-wide access.
relationships: Individual UI components are consolidated into a single entry point to simplify imports across the application.
Composite components like cards and fields organize smaller, atomic building blocks into logical sections.
Interaction-driven components like tooltips and select menus rely on provider wrappers to manage application-level state and context.
designDecisions: Use of specialized sub-components to provide granular control over the internal structure of complex UI elements.
Implementation of consistent theme and style tokens across all components to ensure visual harmony.
Provision of wrapper components for third-party libraries to inject standardized styling.
Modular component design favoring composition over monolithic structures.
